questions: Do you enforce multi-factor authentication for all users?
Is MFA required for employee and admin access?
answer: Yes. All workforce access goes through SSO with phishing-resistant MFA enforced; admin access requires hardware keys.

questions: Is customer data encrypted at rest and in transit?
answer: Yes. Data is encrypted at rest with AES-256 via cloud KMS and in transit with TLS 1.2+.

questions: Do you perform annual third-party penetration testing?
answer: Yes. An independent firm performs a penetration test at least annually; the executive summary is available under NDA.
commitment: Share the annual pentest summary under NDA on request

questions: Do you have an incident response plan?
How will you notify us of a security incident affecting our data?
answer: Yes. Our incident response plan is tested annually, and affected customers are notified within 72 hours of a confirmed incident.
commitment: Notify within 72 hours of a confirmed incident affecting customer data

questions: Are you SOC 2 Type II certified?
Can you provide your SOC 2 report?
answer: Yes. We complete an annual SOC 2 Type II audit covering Security, Availability and Confidentiality; the report is available under NDA.

questions: Is customer data used to train AI models?
How do you secure AI features?
answer: No. Customer data is not used to train models. AI features run with zero data retention at the model provider and are tested for prompt injection.
commitment: Do not use customer data to train AI models
